notes: The prompt names its own genre — a base-building, tower-defense and RTS successor — so Strategy leads, with Simulation named second for the stated idle progression and extractor economy; loading Simulation added no option Strategy did not already carry, but the game is honestly both. Base Defense is the preset: a base built on open ground and defended against attackers who path dynamically, which matches the prompt's explicit rejection of dumb pathfinding, so terrain-open rather than lane-actor-track, whose single hard-coded lane the prompt contradicts outright. I added buildzone-plot for the proximity-gated base building that is the whole of Layer 1 and collectible-nodes for the Mush, Goo, Bones, Electricity and Scrap sites, and terrain-relief because the author makes height, mud and tall grass a design pillar — that is the only thing taking this off flat P0 and onto P0 + tiered. With no user to ask I scoped to the author's single backyard vertical slice, left the expanding world tiers and neighbouring yards out as the separate instances they said they would be, dropped gate-progression with the territory expansion that goes with them, and judged the player to be a tiny walking avatar rather than a camera, so this is not a SET.
